# Effective prompting

Source: https://developers.openai.com/codex/prompting

## Prompt components

For substantial work, describe the desired goal, the context that can change the result, the expected output, and the boundaries that prevent unwanted actions. A prompt does not need a rigid template; include only the details that improve the result.

## Coding tasks

When asking Codex to change a repository, name the behavior you want, point to relevant files or reproduction steps, preserve important constraints, and state how the change should be verified. Follow-up messages can steer active work or queue a later request.

## Verification

For important work, request a final check and review the result before publishing or using it. A useful coding verification step runs the smallest relevant tests and reports the commands and outcomes.
